name: Tesla Maintenance Reminder
tagline: Tracks Tesla wear items and nudges you when each service is due
description: Keeps a running record of the wear items a Tesla owner has to think about: tire wear and rotation, alignment, the 12-volt battery, camera housings, filtration (HEPA and cabin), and wiper blades. When an item comes due it sends a nudge, so the booking happens on your schedule instead of after a failure.
author: jbaladjay_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
